title: GitaGround release: benchmark, labels, embeddings and reconstruction scripts for Canonical Verse Grounding
description: Route (a) release for the paper 'GitaGround: A Bilingual Benchmark and Structured Digression Veto for Canonical Verse Grounding in Spoken Lectures'. 59 lectures, 2,583 passages, Kannada and English. Contains the lecture catalogue and metadata, verse-theme file, passage grid (offsets and hashes, no text), gold labels, second-pass labels and adjudication, all LLM labels, embeddings and features, frozen system files, the experiment log, paper_tables/ with the 59-lecture labels, scripts and outputs behind every table of the paper, and a reconstruct/ folder with source URLs and the ASR (Sarvam AI saaras:v3), segmentation and alignment scripts. Lecture audio and transcript text are not distributed. Code: MIT. Labels and data: CC BY-NC 4.0.
